feed_title: XXL Memory Foam Dog Bed for Giant Breeds 132 x 104cm, 20cm Deep, Three Bolsters with Open Front, Navy Linen Effect, Fleece | PawLunova Mardale
descriptionHtml:
132 × 104cm. Over twice a large bed. Navy for the lounge.

Mardale is an XXL memory foam dog bed, 132 × 104 × 20cm, with memory foam over an egg-crate layer, three bolstered sides and navy linen-effect side panels.

You have stopped believing the word large. It was on the label of the last two, and a Great Dane still folded onto one like a letter into an envelope.

This footprint is more than twice the floor area of a typical 90 × 70cm large bed. All of the dog ends up on foam, including the parts that normally hang off.

What they get

  • More than twice the floor area: 132 × 104cm against a typical 90 × 70cm large bed.
  • Two foam layers at 20cm: A very heavy dog flattens a single thin one.
  • Three bolstered sides and an open front to walk in: Somewhere to put a head that weighs as much as a small dog.
  • Navy linen-effect panels: Smart from the doorway, fleece soft under the dog.

Best for: giant breeds, and owners on their third bed sold as large.

Why it is worth the money

£165 is close to the floor for this size. Most brands stop at large. Two foam layers, 20cm deep, with a 5-year no-flatten guarantee on the core. Divide £165 by the 1825 nights that guarantee runs and it is about 9p a night. You get 100 nights at home to find out. If not, free UK mainland collection and a full refund.

It comes in navy and nothing else, in one size only. A bed with this footprint lives somewhere permanent, so choose its spot before it lands.

Mardale or Longsleddale? Same footprint and the same two foam layers. Mardale is the navy one at £165. Longsleddale is £185.

Size and fit

SizeExternal (cm)Suits
XXL, one size132 × 104 × 20Great Dane, Newfoundland, other giant breeds

Measure your dog lying on their side, nose to base of tail, and add 15 to 20cm. These are outside measurements and the bolsters take up some of that. Not sure? Message us their breed and weight and we will tell you honestly whether it fits.

Everyday care

The cover follows its sewn-in care label. Air-dry fully before refitting. Never wash or soak the foam.

If your dog is in pain, recovering or finding it hard to move, speak to your vet about the right resting surface. A bed is for comfort. It is not a treatment.

100 nights to decide. 5 years on the foam.

Try it at home for 100 nights from delivery. If it is not right, we arrange free UK mainland collection and a full refund. One trial per household; damage and other exclusions apply. The foam core also has a 5-year no-flatten guarantee under normal domestic use, subject to the guarantee terms; cover wear and pet damage are not included. Read the full returns and guarantee terms. This guarantee is in addition to your statutory rights and does not affect them.

The questions we get asked most

What size should I get?

One size, 132 × 104cm outside. Measure the dog and the gap.

What does delivery cost?

Nothing over £40. Timings show against your postcode.

Can I pay in instalments?

Yes. Instalment options appear at checkout.

How much do the bolsters take?

Part of the 132 × 104cm. The inside figure is not published.

Will an older dog manage it?

The front is open rather than walled. The rest is a vet question.

Can I actually wash it?

The cover does, at the temperature on its label.

What if they snub it?

Inside 100 nights it goes back at our cost, refunded in full.

Free standard UK delivery on orders over £40. Check delivery timings and any product-specific lead time.
